startUrls.title: Post URLs or IDs
startUrls.description: X/Twitter post, thread, or Article URLs (or bare numeric IDs) to scrape. One dataset item is produced per entry.

url.title: URL
url.description: Post/Article URL or bare numeric status ID.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of start URLs to process per run (hard cap 50, matching platform memory limits).

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Retrieval strategy. Auto tries fxtwitter (threads + Articles) then falls back to vxtwitter, syndication, and graphql.

downloadMedia.title: Download media files
downloadMedia.description: Upload original-resolution images and mp4 video/GIF sources to the key-value store (plus an optional ZIP bundle). Off by default; URLs are always returned.

images.title: Download images
images.description: Upload original-resolution images to the key-value store.

videos.title: Download videos
videos.description: Upload the best mp4 source of each video to the key-value store.

gifs.title: Download GIFs
gifs.description: Upload the mp4 source of each GIF to the key-value store.

zip.title: Bundle media as ZIP
zip.description: Store all downloaded media for the run as a single ZIP file.

outputFormat.title: Thread output format
outputFormat.description: Flat emits one post list per item; nested adds a thread object; both emits both.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxy is strongly recommended: scraping without one risks IP blocks.
